cause_quote: Under `if (params.worktreeId && params.root && !params.historical)`, the diff added `readRoot = backing.root;` and changed file resolution to `root: boundary.readRoot ?? boundary.root`, routing reads to retained private checkout bytes even after a canonical save or when the session ran on the host.
user_saw: The Control UI could show old file contents after a successful save or when a host-only session still had a retained sandbox checkout.
summary: The fix imports successful canonical saves into the private checkout before guest writers resume and limits private checkout reads to sandbox sessions.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: the existing save handler wrote to the canonical workspace, and the parent resolved file reads against that same workspace after checkpointing. PR #194885 switched reads to the retained private checkout without checking whether the session was sandboxed and left the canonical write outside the checkpoint with no import back into that checkout. The fix adds coverage for both save-then-reload and host-only reads with a retained checkout.
